title: Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4.07 contains a predictable session cookie vulnerability that allows…
description: Teracom TCW122B-CM devices running firmware versions before 4.07 have a vulnerability in their session cookie generation. The session cookies are predictable because they are derived from a 32-bit tick counter based on device uptime and login timing. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions by guessing or brute-forcing the session cookie. Successful exploitation can lead to full control over device relays, settings, and administrator credentials.
